baseline.description: No change: keep the current setup
baseline.variant_facts:
The merchandise under consideration is a The country of origin of an electrical actuator. The product of CBP ruling N348465, as its facts describe it. The The country of origin of an electrical actuator is assembled in Canada using components sourced from China.

The DC motor, gearbox assembly, screw drive, housings, sensor printed circuit board assembly (PCBA) and electrical apparatus are produced in China. 

Final assembly in Canada: fasten the motor to the gearbox, insert the components and fasten with screws; solder the electrical apparatus and secure the wires to the motor actuator; test, lubricate and package.

key_factors: (b)(1) essential character of the DC motor
prediction.decisive_step: Production of the DC motor in China
prediction.reasoning: Electrical actuators incorporating an electric motor and gearbox are classified in heading 8501. Under 19 CFR 102.20(o), heading 8501 requires a tariff shift from any other heading. Because the Chinese-origin DC motor is already classified in heading 8501, it fails to undergo the required tariff shift during assembly in Canada under 102.11(a)(3). Proceeding to 102.11(b)(1) and 102.18(b), the non-shifting DC motor imparts the essential character to the actuator (consistent with H303140), making the country of origin China.
